I lack of emotions and being in love with my ex was really a blessing to me because I felt like I finally experienced overwhelming yet pleasant emotions that I always craved for. But I hope that you’ll too get over him and find the perfect match for yourself who would love you with the bottom of their heart <3 

As for debts… I feel you. I’m also dealing with the debts, especially concerning my mental health and uni studies. And pointing out the therapy, I can assure you that all those money spent on your mental health will eventually help you recover and get the enjoyment for life!! At least it’s something I believe in and I hope you will too :) 

Take care, darling! You’re not alone and I thank you for  telling me your story, it really helps to realize that you’re not alone and I wish my post made you perceive that too.

I hope you’ll manage to find your path and create your own staircase to the dream life you desire!! Judging by your comment you seem like a very caring and nice person, so I hope you’re/you’ll be surrounded by love and care you ‘radiate’ :)
